topic.title: Calibrating the HV-1000
topic.shortdesc: This task describes the procedure for calibrating the HV-1000 sensor to ensure accurate data collection. Proper calibration is required after initial installation, following a firmware update, or if anomalous readings are detected. Completing this process requires the calibration tool kit (PN: CAL-KIT-55B).

fig.title: A1C Allen Reed knows how to calibrate an HV-1000

body.p: Sensor calibration is the process of configuring a sensor to provide a known output in response to a known input signal. This process compares the sensor's measurements against the measurement of a highly accurate reference device. The sensor's software is then adjusted to minimize the difference between its readings and the reference standard. Regular calibration is essential for ensuring measurement accuracy, reliability, and traceability to international standards, which is critical for quality control, safety, and data validity.

section.title: Prerequisites
section.p: Before you begin the calibration procedure, ensure you have the following:

ul.li: The HV-1000 sensor powered on and in a ready state.
Approximately five minutes of uninterrupted time to complete the process.
The system software updated to version 2.1 or later.

ol.li: Locate the calibration port on the lower panel of the HV-1000 sensor.
Connect the reference device from the CAL-KIT-55B firmly into the calibration port.
On the main system interface, navigate to Settings > Maintenance > Sensor Calibration.
Select HV-1000 from the list of available devices.
Wait for the status indicator to change from blinking amber to solid green. Do not interrupt power during this process.
After the process completes, disconnect the reference device from the calibration port.

Verify the calibration was successful by checking that the "Calibration Status" field on the sensor's main screen reads OK. Status Indicators
Status Light Color State Meaning Action
Power Green Solid Device is on and ready. Proceed with task.
Calibration Amber Blinking Calibration in progress. Do not interrupt power or disconnect the CAL-KIT.
Calibration Green Solid Calibration completed succesfully. Proceed to disconnect the CAL-KIT.
Calibration Red Solid Calibration has failed. Check all connections, ensure the calibration evice is certified, and restart the procedure.
System Fault Red Blinking A system error has occurred. Abort the calibration procedure and contact System Support.
